old:
The reported approximately \SI{85}{\watt} V2 point must be repeated with
identified hardware, rework, magnetics, resonant values, controller target,
firmware source, saved settings, and live mode. Version, status, and
configuration exports are recorded with the test.

The baseline record must identify AC input, output setting and negotiation,
load/cable, auxiliary supplies, cooling, ambient, and duration. Probe scaling
and zero must be checked. If the original \SI{85}{\watt} configuration cannot
be reconstructed, a new baseline must state the known differences.
new:
The reported V2 operating point near \SI{85}{\watt} must be repeated with
the hardware, rework, magnetics, resonant values, controller target, firmware version, settings and mode
identified. AC input, output setting and negotiation, load and cable, auxiliary
supplies, cooling, ambient and duration must also be recorded. Probe scaling
and zero must be checked. If the original configuration cannot be reconstructed,
the known differences must be stated.
reason: Connects the baseline condition to the measurements and removes a list of configuration exports.
facts_preserved: Reported approximately 85 W point remains unverified; operating configuration and differences must be identified.

old: The matched \SI{79.89}{\watt} tests on the modified V1.0 assembly provide a connector-output baseline (\cref{ch:results}). Later V2 secondary-output tests reached higher power with voltage droop and continued heating (\cref{sec:res-v2-testing}); thermal-endurance tests remain incomplete. The V1.0 outline is \SI{202.77}{\milli\metre} by \SI{72.77}{\milli\metre}; V2 assembly dimensions must be measured separately before calculating its power density. The earlier reported \SI{85}{\watt} V2 point remains a plan reference.
new: The matched \SI{79.89}{\watt} tests on the modified V1.0 assembly provide a connector-output baseline (\cref{ch:results}). The V1.0 outline is \SI{202.77}{\milli\metre} by \SI{72.77}{\milli\metre}; V2 assembly dimensions must be measured separately before calculating its power density.

old: Bridge commutation, diode capacitance, charge-pump current, and loop inductance couple this path to the half bridge. Filter attenuation must therefore be measured in the installed circuit. The assembly's input behavior was assessed from the input-current measurements in Chapter~\ref{ch:results}. Measurements on both sides of the filter are still needed to determine how much noise it attenuates.
new: Bridge commutation, diode capacitance, charge-pump current, and loop inductance couple this path to the half bridge. The assembly's input behavior was assessed from the input-current measurements in Chapter~\ref{ch:results}; measurements on both sides of the installed filter are still needed to determine its noise attenuation.
reason: Combines the repeated filter measurement requirement with its reason.
facts_preserved: Input-current assessment and need for measurements on both sides of installed filter.

old: The conversion scales must match the installed circuit. V1.0 includes an external \SI{2.5}{\volt} reference, omitted in V1.1, while the final firmware defaults to a \SI{3.3}{\volt} ADC reference. Divider ratios, amplifier scale, buffers, gain, and offset all affect the conversion. The conversion scales still need to be checked against measured circuit and ADC-pin voltages. The calibration settings are given in \Cref{sec:ctrl-feedback}.
new: V1.0 includes an external \SI{2.5}{\volt} reference, omitted in V1.1, while the final firmware defaults to a \SI{3.3}{\volt} ADC reference. Divider ratios, amplifier scale, buffers, gain, and offset also affect the conversion, so the scales must be checked against measured circuit and ADC-pin voltages. The calibration settings are given in \Cref{sec:ctrl-feedback}.
reason: Connects the scale check to its circuit causes and removes repeated instruction.
facts_preserved: Reference values and revision distinction; scale verification and calibration reference.

old: The local supply rails, UART communication, inhibited burst-enable output PA10, carrier outputs, and analog feedback were checked during bring-up before the loop was closed. The LMG2652 bias must be within its operating range, and a valid secondary-voltage reading from input PA1 requires power to the isolated sensing circuit.
new: The local supply rails, UART communication, inhibited burst-enable output PA10, carrier outputs, and analog feedback were checked during bring-up before the loop was closed. The LMG2652 bias must be within its operating range before switching.
reason: Removes the repeated explanation of isolated sensing power, already stated in the preceding paragraph and linked to precharge below.
facts_preserved: Bring-up checks and bias requirement; isolated feedback startup remains described.

old: Changing the resonant branch affects tank current, gain, and the charge available to change VSW during commutation. Waveform comparisons therefore need the fitted inductor arrangement. The installed path must be measured before the model is used to select another change.
new: Changing the resonant branch affects tank current, gain, and the charge available to change VSW during commutation. The fitted inductor arrangement must therefore be accounted for when comparing waveforms, and the installed path measured before selecting another change with the model.
reason: Connects the component arrangement and measurement requirements to the physical effects.
facts_preserved: Tank current, gain, commutation charge, fitted arrangement and need to measure installed path.

old: The exported settings are kept with each test because calibration or threshold changes can alter the response without changing the firmware version. Connector voltage, load current, and AC input power are measured with external instruments for performance calculations. These measurements also provide an independent check on the controller readings.
new: Calibration and threshold changes can alter the response without changing the firmware version, so the settings must be recorded with each test. External measurements of connector voltage, load current, and AC input power provide the performance calculations and a check on the controller readings.
reason: States the engineering reason for retaining settings and joins the external measurement roles.
facts_preserved: Settings affect response without a version change; external measurements support performance calculations and check controller readings.
